name: Parres (Spain)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Parres (quartered with a mountain, a bridge, a fleur-de-lis and figures, in an ornate frame).
history: Municipal flag of Parres; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Parres arms — quartered in an ornate frame
